gpuScope: device-wide nvidia-smi memory.used; released = within 64 MiB of the pre-run baseline
findings: Every stage exited within 80 ms of TerminateProcess and device GPU memory returned within 64 MiB of baseline within 140 ms; no compute process remained
No output files existed at any probed stage: yue-synth writes tokens, latents, score, audio and replay JSON only after decoding completes

Not probed: the final write phase. yue-synth writes each output directly to its target path, so a kill there can leave partial files; the worker must write to temporary names and promote after completion
yue-synth has no cancellation channel; Stop in the app therefore relies on process termination for this candidate unless a cooperative-cancel patch is added in Phase 3
limitations: GPU release is device-wide nvidia-smi memory.used, not per-process driver accounting
One kill per stage on one machine; not a repeated stress test
Kill is issued by the parent that launched the process; OS job-object behavior on parent crash is Phase 3 work
